About.heroDescription: A multidisciplinary team that believes in people and their capacity to redesign their path — at any age and at any point in life.
About.missionText: Senda was created to offer a space where people can consider their professional future with calm, clarity, and specialized guidance. In a world where artificial intelligence has transformed the rules of the market, we believe that self-awareness and strategy can help each person find a place of their own.
About.whatWeDoSubtitle: We combine three pillars to support your professional transition.
About.pillarPsychometricDesc: Guidance tools based on recognized models to explore interests, aptitudes, and values.
About.pillarHumanDesc: A team experienced in talent and career strategy that listens, guides, and helps you make informed decisions.
About.pillarAiDesc: We use AI as a supporting tool to analyze trends, personalize recommendations, and strengthen your process — always with human oversight.
About.valueWarmthDesc: Every person who comes to us brings a unique story. We listen with empathy, without judgment, and build from there.
About.valueRigorDesc: We use recognized models, a structured methodology, and artificial intelligence as a complement, never as a replacement for human judgment.
About.valueClarityDesc: We do not sell illusions. We help you see your situation honestly so you can make informed, strategic decisions.
About.valueSupportDesc: You are not a number. Every process is personal, unfolds at your pace, and includes a team that remains present throughout the transition.
About.ctaTitle: Ready to begin finding your direction?
About.ctaDescription: You can begin by putting into words what is changing. The initial diagnostic helps us guide you toward a possible journey.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Text: At Senda, we collect the information you provide when using our services: your name, email address, professional information, assessment answers and results, submitted inquiries, and technical data essential to security and operation.
Privacy.section2Text: We use this information to provide requested services, save your result, answer inquiries, protect and improve the platform, and comply with legal obligations. Informational communications require your consent, and you can unsubscribe from them.
Privacy.section3Text: We apply authentication controls, database permissions, server-side validation, protection against abusive automation, and encrypted communications. No system offers absolute security, but we limit access and collection to what is necessary to operate the service.
Privacy.section4Text: The free assessment provides guidance rather than a clinical diagnosis. To generate and save it, the necessary answers and work-related details may be processed by infrastructure, database, security, and artificial-intelligence providers under our instructions. We do not send your name, email, phone number, or address to the model. Access is limited to team members who need the information to provide a requested service or respond to an inquiry.
Privacy.section5Text: We use essential cookies for authentication, security, and preferences. If non-essential technologies are introduced, they must respect the choice presented on the site.
Privacy.section6Text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, withdraw consent, and ask how your information is handled. We retain information for as long as needed to provide the service and meet applicable obligations.
Privacy.section7Text: For questions about this policy, email us at <email>contacto@senda.com</email>.

Terms.title: Terms and Conditions
Terms.section1Text: Senda is a career direction and strategy platform. Its services include assessments, self-awareness tools, and individual guidance sessions.
Terms.section2Text: You must create an account and provide accurate, up-to-date information to access certain services. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and protecting access to your account.
Terms.section3Text: Assessments and guidance tools invite reflection and can be complemented by an individual conversation; they are not fixed definitions and do not determine study or career decisions.
Terms.section4Text: Before a journey begins, Senda privately and clearly communicates its engagement terms and available payment methods. No process is confirmed without explicit acceptance of those terms.
Terms.section5Text: Sessions may be canceled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance at no cost. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are nonrefundable. Session packages are nonrefundable once the process has begun.
Terms.section6Text: All platform content, including text, designs, methodology, assessments, and session materials, is the property of Senda and is protected by intellectual property laws. Reproduction without express authorization is prohibited.
Terms.section7Text: Senda does not guarantee specific results from using its services. Our role is to provide tools, information, and guidance for each transition. Career decisions remain the responsibility of each individual.
Terms.section8Text: For questions about these terms, email us at <email>contacto@senda.com</email>.

CareerQuiz.metadataDescription: Discover your career anchor through Edgar Schein's model. A free interpretation to help you understand your journey and guide your next steps.
CareerQuiz.introTitle: Your career GPS: explore what drives you at work
CareerQuiz.introSubtitle: An inner compass for understanding your journey more clearly.
CareerQuiz.introParagraph1: Edgar Schein developed this model to explore the combination of abilities, motivations, and values that a person seeks to preserve throughout their working life.
CareerQuiz.introParagraph2: Your career anchor is the unique combination of abilities, motivations, and values that you would not easily give up. Understanding it can help you make choices that are more consistent with who you are and recognize what you need to protect during a time of change.
CareerQuiz.questionsScaleDesc: Answer each question using the scale from 1 (Never) to 6 (Always)
CareerQuiz.transitionTitle: One last step — your result is almost ready!
CareerQuiz.transitionSubtitle: There is one final choice to help identify which aspects are truly nonnegotiable for you.
CareerQuiz.transitionInstruction: You'll review all 40 statements again. This time, choose the 3 that best represent what you need to preserve in your professional life, even as your role or context changes.
CareerQuiz.transitionNote: Your final three choices will carry additional weight in the calculation, helping us identify your primary anchor more clearly.
CareerQuiz.bonusSubtitle: Choose only 3 statements in total. You can review every group before confirming.
CareerQuiz.bonusInstruction: Choose the 3 statements that matter most to you
CareerQuiz.prequizSubtitle: To prepare an initial interpretation of your Dominant Anchor, we need some basic information about your current context.
CareerQuiz.resultsScheinQuote: A career anchor brings together the abilities, motivations, and values that a person seeks to preserve throughout their professional journey. — A summary of Edgar Schein's model
CareerQuiz.resultsDominantText: Because your dominant anchor is {article} {name}, any professional move should protect this central part of your profile. Treat it as a starting point for reflection, not a fixed definition. If you'd like to explore it further, you can ask our team for guidance.
CareerQuiz.resultsAiLoadingTitle: We are preparing your personalized interpretation...
CareerQuiz.resultsAiLoadingText: Connecting your 40 responses with your profile as {occupation}.
CareerQuiz.resultsClosingTitle: Would you prefer to explore your career and next steps with professional guidance?
CareerQuiz.resultsClosingText: If you are navigating a decision, a change, or a period of uncertainty, Senda's individual guidance offers a space to explore your motivations, revisit your career story, and build possible next steps.
CareerQuiz.authModalDescription: Sign in to save your progress and revisit your Career Anchor result whenever you need it.
CareerQuiz.authNote: Registration is secure and allows us to store your results for future sessions.
CareerQuiz.calculateError: We couldn't calculate your dominant anchor. Restart the test and try again.
CareerQuiz.analysisUnavailable: We couldn't generate your personalized feedback right now, but you can still review the complete ranking.

CareerQuiz.introBlocksText: Move forward in manageable sections, without one endless screen.

CareerAnchorIntro.metadataDescription: A test to understand what motivations influence your career decisions, before deciding your next steps.
CareerAnchorIntro.label: Career Anchors Test
CareerAnchorIntro.title: The motivations behind your career decisions
CareerAnchorIntro.intro: Throughout a career, certain motivations can become especially important. They influence the challenges we pursue, the environments where we thrive, and the decisions we make when something needs to change.
CareerAnchorIntro.introContinuation: The Career Anchors Test helps you explore those motivations and better understand what you are looking for in your relationship with work today.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit1: Recognize the motivations that carry the most weight in your professional life.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit2: Understand which working conditions support your engagement.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit3: Identify tensions between your current experience and what you are seeking.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit4: Evaluate changes and opportunities with clearer criteria.
CareerAnchorIntro.benefit5: Open new questions about your career and your current stage.
CareerAnchorIntro.clarification: The result does not define a profession or determine a decision. It is a starting point for reflecting on your career, your motivations, and the possibilities you want to explore.
CareerAnchorIntro.accompanimentTitle: Would you prefer to explore your career and next steps with professional guidance?
CareerAnchorIntro.accompanimentDescription: If you are navigating a decision, a change, or a period of uncertainty, Senda's individual guidance offers a space to explore your motivations, revisit your career story, and build possible next steps.

hero.description: Senda supports study and work decisions, and new professional stages, through a clear methodology, human conversations, and possible next steps.

journeys.title: A different path for each moment.
journeys.intro: Not every professional question begins in the same place. Senda offers two clear, personal journeys grounded in the reality of each stage.

compass.label: Journey 01
compass.title: Compass
compass.lead: It is not about choosing for life, but about beginning to recognize a direction of your own.
compass.description: For young people deciding what to study, how to approach the world of work, or which alternatives are worth exploring. It is not a traditional test: it is a process of conversation, research, and decision-making.

newStage.label: Journey 02
newStage.title: New Professional Stage
newStage.lead: Transform your trajectory without losing sight of everything you have already built.
newStage.description: For experienced professionals, leaders, and managers who need to revisit their identity, change roles or industries, reposition themselves, or build a clear strategy for what comes next.

situations.title: Two journeys, different situations.
situations.intro: Recognizing where you are helps you choose a process that fits your moment, without rigid labels or ready-made answers.

compass.title: Compass may support you if…
compass.description: You are beginning to connect your interests with real study and work options.
compass.point1: You do not know what to study or want to revisit a recent choice.
compass.point2: You have several options and need criteria to compare them.
compass.point3: You want to better understand your interests, motivations, and ways of learning.
compass.point4: You need to move from uncertainty toward a possible first direction.

newStage.title: New Professional Stage may support you if…
newStage.description: You have experience and need to turn the desire for change into a direction and a strategy.
newStage.point1: Your role, industry, or way of working no longer represents you.
newStage.point2: You want to change without losing the value of your trajectory.
newStage.point3: You need to organize your positioning, narrative, or search.
newStage.point4: You are leading, building a venture, or navigating a concrete career change.

method.title: Direction is built in stages.
method.intro: Each journey combines listening, exploration, and strategy. The sequence guides the work while adapting to each person's story and present moment.

listen.title: Listen
listen.description: We put the question, its context, and what you need to protect into words.

map.title: Map
map.description: We recognize experiences, motivations, strengths, constraints, and possibilities.

define.title: Define
define.description: We build criteria and a possible direction connected to your reality.

move.title: Move
move.description: We turn that direction into decisions, conversations, and next steps.

phases.title: Each process has its own stages.
phases.intro: See what Compass and New Professional Stage explore, from the initial question to a clear roadmap.

team.title: Professional judgment and human listening.
team.intro: Senda brings together complementary perspectives to support complex decisions with clarity, respect, and attention to each trajectory.

multidisciplinary.title: A multidisciplinary perspective
multidisciplinary.description: We integrate guidance, talent, career strategy, and an understanding of the world of work.

human.title: Human support
human.description: Every process includes real conversations, professional judgment, and space to think without pressure.

rigor.title: Method and rigor
rigor.description: We use recognized tools as support and turn what we explore into well-grounded decisions.

faq.title: Before you begin.
faq.intro: Clear answers to help you understand which journey may support you and what the process is like.

choose.question: How do I know which of the two journeys I need?
choose.answer: Compass begins with questions about study, interests, and first work decisions. New Professional Stage supports people with an established trajectory who need to transform it, reposition themselves, or build a strategy for what comes next. If you are still unsure, the initial diagnostic helps locate your present moment.

compass.question: Is Compass a test that tells me which degree to choose?
compass.answer: No. It includes exploration tools, but the process centers on conversation, researching alternatives, building criteria, and recognizing a direction of your own. No result decides for you.

newStage.question: What does New Professional Stage include?
newStage.answer: It combines a review of your trajectory and professional identity with the definition of a direction, positioning, narrative, and movement strategy.

format.question: Are meetings virtual or in person?
format.answer: Meetings take place online so you can sustain the process from wherever you are. Any available in-person alternative is discussed before you begin.

duration.question: How long does each journey take?
duration.answer: The duration depends on the journey and is discussed before you begin. The stages follow a clear sequence, with room to adapt them to each person's particular moment.

diagnostic.question: How does the initial diagnostic work?
diagnostic.answer: It is a brief, non-clinical form about your situation, what you need, and how urgent the change feels. It helps the team guide you; it does not replace a professional assessment or diagnosis.

results.question: What will I receive at the end?
results.answer: You finish with a personalized synthesis, decision criteria, and a roadmap. The specific materials depend on the journey and the work completed during the process.

final.title: You do not need to have everything figured out to begin.
final.description: You can begin by telling us what is changing. From there, we build a direction and possible next steps.

journey.title: Step by step.
journey.note: Each stage adapts to the person's specific moment; the sequence guides the work rather than acting as a rigid formula.

cta.title: You can begin without having the answer.
cta.description: The initial diagnostic helps us understand your moment and guide you with clarity, care, and no pressure.

compass.title: Compass
compass.lead: It is not about choosing for life, but about beginning to recognize a direction of your own.
compass.cardDescription: Explore interests, experiences, and possibilities to build criteria and a first direction of your own.
compass.metaDescription: Compass is Senda's journey for exploring study and work options, building criteria, and recognizing a direction of your own.
compass.objective: Turn a broad question about what to study or how to approach work into researched alternatives, personal criteria, and possible next steps.
compass.forWhom: For young people finishing school, starting a course of study, revisiting a recent choice, or looking for a first direction in study and work.

question.title: Name the question
question.description: We begin with your present moment: doubts, expectations, educational experiences, external pressures, and questions that do not yet have answers.

signals.title: Recognize your own signals
signals.description: We explore interests, motivations, abilities, values, and experiences that help reveal which activities and environments make sense for you.

worlds.title: Discover possible worlds
worlds.description: We connect the exploration with real degrees, training paths, occupations, and ways of working without reducing the search to one option.

criteria.title: Build criteria
criteria.description: We organize what you need to consider when choosing: content, ways of learning, context, concrete possibilities, and life plans.

alternatives.title: Research alternatives
alternatives.description: We compare options and design small validation actions: talk, observe, try, research, and ask better questions.

direction.title: Recognize a direction
direction.description: We integrate the work into prioritized alternatives and a plan for exploration or decision-making over the coming months.

takeaways.signals: An understanding of your interests, motivations, and strengths.
takeaways.map: A map of study and work options.
takeaways.alternatives: Prioritized alternatives and questions to validate them.
takeaways.plan: A plan for exploration and next steps.

newStage.title: New Professional Stage
newStage.lead: Transform your trajectory without losing sight of everything you have already built.
newStage.cardDescription: Read your experience anew, define a direction, and turn change into positioning, strategy, and movement.
newStage.metaDescription: New Professional Stage supports experienced people as they transform their trajectory, define their positioning, and build a strategy.
newStage.objective: Integrate identity, experience, motivations, and context to define a professional direction, a narrative of your own, and a sustainable movement strategy.
newStage.forWhom: For experienced professionals, leaders, and managers who want to change roles or industries, reposition themselves, build a venture, return to the market, or shape a new stage.

moment.title: Read the moment
moment.description: We organize what is changing, what has run its course, what you need to protect, and which concrete conditions affect the decision.

trajectory.title: Read your trajectory anew
trajectory.description: We recover experiences, achievements, lessons, and patterns to recognize accumulated value and what you do not want to repeat.

identity.title: Revisit your professional identity
identity.description: We explore how you define yourself beyond a job title, which motivations remain active, and which new professional version you want to build.

criteria.title: Define criteria
criteria.description: We integrate aspirations, responsibilities, constraints, and real possibilities to assess scenarios with clarity.

direction.title: Choose a direction
direction.description: We prioritize one scenario: redefine your role, change industries, take on another function, build a venture, or combine paths.

positioning.title: Build positioning
positioning.description: We translate your experience into a clear, relevant value proposition for the people and spaces you want to reach.

strategy.title: Design the strategy
strategy.description: We organize narrative, profile, network, conversations, search, and concrete actions to make the chosen direction visible.

integrate.title: Integrate and move
integrate.description: We close with priorities, decisions, and a roadmap for sustaining next steps without disregarding your history.

takeaways.trajectory: An integrated map of your trajectory.
takeaways.strengths: An understanding of your strengths, motivations, and resources.
takeaways.narrative: A clear professional narrative of your own.
takeaways.positioning: Positioning that fits the stage you are seeking.
takeaways.roadmap: A roadmap with actions and priorities.

meta.title: Initial diagnostic
meta.description: A brief first step to understand the change you are going through and identify which journey may support you.

InitialDiagnostic.description: You don't need to know which process you need. These questions help us understand your moment and guide you more clearly.
InitialDiagnostic.disclaimer: This is a non-clinical guidance tool. It does not replace a professional assessment or diagnosis.
